objective: Close the Wave 2 permission contract: declare the required Contacts, Photos, and Calendar usage descriptions and cover the permission-facing source status without claiming MacBook runtime validation.

criteria.promise: The signed app metadata contains the usage descriptions required by the implemented Contacts, Photos, and calendar/reminder paths, using the repository's existing localization/Info.plist conventions.
Permission-facing behavior remains fail-closed and actionable for denied/not-determined states; no success is reported without authorization.
Focused tests or static validation cover the new metadata/permission contract; runtime MacBook/TCC behavior is explicitly left as a manual gate.

verification_gates.procedure: Inspect Scripts/Info.plist, entitlements, and existing source strings; validate plist syntax and required keys.
verification_gates.expected: All required usage keys exist with non-empty user-facing text and no unrelated metadata churn.

verification_gates.procedure: Inspect EventKit/Contacts/Photos handlers and focused tests.
verification_gates.expected: Denied/not-determined paths remain typed failures or actionable unavailable states.

verification_gates.procedure: Run focused tests/static checks and inspect git diff --check.
verification_gates.expected: Checks pass; no runtime permission claim is invented.

recon_evidence: Current Scripts/Info.plist was inspected; handlers and focused tests were inspected. The only remaining unknown is runtime MacBook behavior, explicitly treated as a manual verification gate rather than a dispatch blocker.

first_checkpoint.evidence: Required usage-key inventory and focused permission-path check.
